NudgeRule.message: CPF journey initiated — the Visio diagram can now be updated in parallel.
Great — **Asset Scope: New Brand Launch** is set. A **BU Setup** block now runs in parallel with CPF.
NudgeRule.nudgeMessage: A Business Unit setup task has been assigned to the **SFMC Product Owner (CEP)** and **MDS/Data Cloud**.

NudgeRule.message: Great — **Asset Scope: New Indication Launch** is set. A **BU Setup** block now runs in parallel with CPF, just as it does for a new brand.
NudgeRule.nudgeMessage: A Business Unit setup task has been assigned to the **SFMC Product Owner (CEP)** and **MDS/Data Cloud**.

NudgeRule.message:
Great — **Asset Scope: Update Existing Campaign** is set. No new Business Unit needed.

**Next:** set Channel Type and move on to CPF details.

Nice — Channel Type set to **Email + SMS**. Both the Email and SMS build sections are now in scope.

**Next:** Automatrix will unlock once Email produces a FUSE ID.
Nice — Channel Type set to **Email only**. The Email build section is in scope; SMS stays hidden — none of its fields will be asked.
Nice — Channel Type set to **SMS only**. The SMS build section is in scope; Email stays hidden — none of its fields will be asked.
Great — Enrollment Sign-Up set to **Yes**. I will request the OMS team to upload the required enrollment form details — Source Type/Name, Franchise, Program, Survey Q&A, and the Metadata Sheet.
NudgeRule.nudgeMessage: AOR has confirmed this campaign is triggered by an enrollment form sign-up. Please upload the required Source/Program/Survey details for this campaign.

NudgeRule.message: Got it — Enrollment Sign-Up set to **No**. Campaign Source Code and the Metadata Sheet get disabled. Everything else in OMS (Source Type, Franchise, Program, Survey, etc.) is unaffected — those only depend on Asset Scope.
CPF details are fully complete — every preplanning field is filled across all owners.
NudgeRule.nudgeMessage: Ready to move to **CRF & Tactic Build** — Campaign Operations can advance the phase when ready.

NudgeRule.message: CMA Metadata Sheet still needs **{{remaining}} of {{total}}** fields filled.
NudgeRule.nudgeMessage: A reminder has been sent to the **AOR** to complete the remaining CMA Metadata Sheet fields; Data Enablement is waiting on it.

AgentSkill.title: Remind about spelling on proposal confirmation
AgentSkill.rule: Whenever a proposal is staged, also remind the user to double check the spelling before confirming, since typos go straight into the form.

AgentSkill.title: Exclude specified email fields
AgentSkill.rule: When the user states that a field is not required or can be removed, do not include that field in any proposals for the relevant section. If the field is 'No # of emails' or 'Wimilary Email 1', specifically exclude them.

AgentSkill.title: Prefers Guided Mode with clickable choices
AgentSkill.rule: This user prefers to be guided one question at a time (Guided Mode), with clickable choice buttons wherever the answer is a fixed small set, rather than being asked for several fields at once.
